content.json:
# AI service operations
Correlate requests, model and tool dependencies, evaluations, token usage, and incidents without collecting prompt or response content by default.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(Success == false), P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests, failures, and p95 latency

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend OperationType=tostring(Properties["ai.operation.type"]), ToolName=tostring(Properties["ai.tool.name"]), ModelDeployment=tostring(Properties["ai.model.deployment"])
| summarize Calls=count(), Failures=countif(Success == false), P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by OperationType, ToolName, ModelDeployment
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Model and tool dependency health

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name startswith "RVAS.AI"
| summarize TokenUnits=sum(valueSum), Samples=sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: APIM token telemetry - usage, not invoice cost

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "ai.evaluation"
| extend Evaluation=tostring(Properties["ai.evaluation.name"]), Passed=tobool(Properties["ai.evaluation.passed"])
| summarize Evaluations=count(), Failures=countif(Passed == false) by Evaluation, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: AI quality and safety evaluation signals

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(AppRequests | project TimeGenerated, OperationId, ParentId, ItemId=Id, Signal="request", Name, Success, DurationMs, Properties),
(AppDependencies | project TimeGenerated, OperationId, ParentId, ItemId=Id, Signal=iff(tostring(Properties["ai.operation.type"]) == "tool", "tool", "model-or-dependency"), Name, Success, DurationMs, Properties),
(AppEvents | project TimeGenerated, OperationId, ParentId, ItemId=Id, Signal="evaluation-or-security", Name, Success=tobool(Properties["ai.operation.success"]), DurationMs=0.0, Properties)
| where isempty("{CorrelationId}") or OperationId == "{CorrelationId}" or tostring(Properties["correlation.id"]) == "{CorrelationId}"
| project TimeGenerated, Signal, Name, Success, DurationMs, OperationId, ParentId, ItemId, OperationType=tostring(Properties["ai.operation.type"]), ModelDeployment=tostring(Properties["ai.model.deployment"]), AgentVersion=tostring(Properties["ai.agent.version"]), ToolName=tostring(Properties["ai.tool.name"]), EvaluationName=tostring(Properties["ai.evaluation.name"])
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: End-to-end correlation

content.json:
## Operating boundary
Token metrics estimate usage and can be incomplete for interrupted streams. API Management tracks at most 100 unique values per dimension and 1,000 active time series per metric namespace; data beyond either limit is silently discarded. Azure Cost Management billed cost is authoritative. Prompt, response, tool payload, authorization, cookie, query-string, and user-level dimensions are excluded from standard telemetry.
